subject: tool:composed-census-t15-promotion-queue
value:
THE PROMOTION BACKLOG, ENUMERATED. The USER's 2026-09-03 directive -- every rule-served function is promotion debt; a close that lands source-exact DELETES its rule in the same commit; EQ->STRICT promotions are pure honesty gains -- had no instrument. config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json is 295685 bytes / 3303 lines in which the rules are not enumerable by eye, and the number that decides how far a function is from source-exact (its RAW differing-word count against the target) was per-function only via wf_word_diff. tools/gdl/composed_census/t15_promotion_queue.py enumerates it live: per rule, RAW differing words against the pre-webfrank body, instruction count, declared atoms, stage count and names, proof mode, whether the mechanism cites a record id, and how many attempt records the function carries (and how many of those carry a literal probed_form). Ranked smallest-first on (words, insns), because what a source lane must close is WORDS.

MEASURED at 46db58dc4 on a green build (ninja prints build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK). 153 rules over 52 units, but 151 DISTINCT FUNCTIONS: game/ui/message::msgDraw and game/world/btricol::LineLineDist carry two rules each. That reconciles the roster against the published split exactly -- `configure.py progress` at this commit reads `STRICT matched 56.66% (2581 fns) + EQUIVALENT 11.02% (151 fns)`, and EQUIVALENT credit is counted per FUNCTION, not per rule. A promotion-backlog count taken off the rule list would be 2 too high.

PROOF MODES: 142 strict (verify_consistent_recolor alone), 8 value_equality_recolor, 3 resting on the unproven_recolor_audit human escape (game/world/btricol::PointLineDist2D, game/audio/mempool::pool_garbage_collect, game/pb/pb_texture::fn_800C72DC). RAW WORDS: 3947 total, median 14, max 204 (game/game/combat::CameraSupervisor). That total is the size of the source-work backlog the postprocessor is currently standing in for.

THE PROVENANCE BACKLOG IS LARGER THAN THE UNPROVEN-PIN BACKLOG, and it is a different set. The Mandatory result policy requires source-exhaustion provenance -- a parked/capped attempt record with literal probed_form axes, CITED by the rule. 68 of 153 rules cite no record id anywhere in their mechanism. 89 rules' functions carry no attempt record with a probed_form. NINE rules' functions carry NO attempt record at all, and those nine are the cleanest instances of the failure mode the policy names, smallest first: game/sys/ml_mem::AllocFile (2 words), game/sys/sysservice::sysClearFlags (2), game/anim/anim::DoAnimation (8), game/game/gamemain::DoWorldAnimation (13), game/sfx/sfx::StartComboFX (18), game/mb/mb_tree::MBNewNode (23), game/game/gamemain::fn_80051480 (40), game/world/items::DistanceToClosestPlayer (42), game/sfx/sfx::fn_80094164 (57). All nine are `strict`, so they are honest as bytes; what they lack is the record that a source lane tried first.

THE CHEAPEST PROMOTIONS, smallest residual first: game/audio/audio::AudioBankQueueName (1 word of 75 insns, one equivalent_copy_form site), game/game/controls::MtapOpenPort (1/83), game/audio/audio::AudioUnloadPart (1/95), game/audio/audio::AudioBankLoadName (1/115), game/world/newcam::fn_8006E654 (1/369), then five rules at 2 words (sysClearFlags 2/4, fn_800D967C 2/13, memCardErrorPrompt 2/25, FontInit 2/45, sysPollResetButton 2/60). A one-word rule is one register-assignment or one live-zero form decision away from deleting itself.

CALIBRATION. The word column was checked against the independent per-function tool on both ends of the range: wf_word_diff reports game/audio/audio::AudioBankQueueName as `75 insns, DIFFERING WORDS = 1` and game/ui/screensaver::print_n_of_m as `68 insns, DIFFERING WORDS = 8`, and the roster reports 1/75 and 8/68. The distinct-function count reconciles with the published EQUIVALENT function count as above. Zero rows failed to measure (0 of 153 with a missing word count).

SCOPE AND HAZARD. `no provenance citation` means no record id appears in the rule's mechanism text; a record may exist uncited, so the column ranks where to LOOK and does not by itself convict a rule. Conversely the 9 zero-attempt-record rows are not ambiguous. The roster reads the RAW pre-postprocess body, so every count is the residual the pin ALREADY CLOSES -- these are not open residuals, and ranking an open-work sweep by this column without dropping pinned rows is the error wf_word_diff's own PIN SCREEN warns about.
